review_calibration.scope: Full design-to-fit comparison of both pairs, using identical criteria.

review.observations: Both A and B depict a long, low, three-door cabinet in a grey-green finish. The overall silhouette and proportions (length-to-height ratio) are consistent between the design and the fit. The fit (B) includes visible rivets along the panel edges, aligning with the requested 'riveted military furniture style', whereas the design (A) is a clean, untextured surface. The fit (B) features recessed, dark rectangular handle cutouts on the doors. The design (A) features prominent, silver-colored, external latch-style hardware.
defects: Hardware mismatch: The design specifies external latches, but the fit renders recessed cutouts.
Style inconsistency: The fit introduces rivets that are not present in the clean design render, creating a discrepancy in the intended surface finish.
fixes: Update the design render to include the rivet details to match the fit's military aesthetic.
Modify the fit's geometry to include the external latch hardware shown in the design, or update the design to reflect the recessed cutout style.

acceptance_rule: Export checks pass and visual fit is at least 7/10; reviewer ready flag is retained separately.
earlier_failure_cause: All earlier cabinet candidates included an extra monitor, which contaminated the guide bounds and could not be cleanly cropped away. The replacement source requires an empty top.
